capabilities: Open code files, dotfiles and extensionless files in an embedded VS Code editor tab
Run VS Code's integrated terminal in a drawer over any Obsidian view
Mirror desktop VS Code extensions, settings, keybindings and profile read-only
Register vault file extensions automatically and exclude chosen ones
Prompt to save unsaved edits on close and carry them across file renames
disambiguation: Not a Monaco-based code highlighter; it runs VS Code's real serve-web workbench, so completions, diagnostics and extensions are VS Code's own.
extras: Not reviewed by Obsidian staff per the manifest. Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.13.0+. On first use it downloads the VS Code server from Microsoft after a licence prompt, and two requests to Microsoft (CDN config files and one marketplace query) cannot be disabled. README documents edge cases, network use and a design record in docs/.
problem: Obsidian's editor handles code files as plain text without IntelliSense, diagnostics, formatting or a terminal, so developers must leave the app or use separate tools to work on code in the vault.

relations.evidence: The plugin runs the official code serve-web on your machine and embeds the real workbench

requires.name: VS Code (or Insiders, VSCodium, Antigravity) with the serve-web command

summary: Embeds the real VS Code editor (via code serve-web) in Obsidian tabs for code files, with VS Code's terminal in a drawer and your extensions and settings.
